svg.title: JGDMS five-service topology with dedicated codebase downloader
svg.desc: Five-service topology. Foreign services register with the Jini lookup service on Host 1. Host 4, the codebase downloader service, listens for ServiceRegistrar events from Host 1. On receiving a registration event containing a codebase URL, Host 4 checks the VerdictRegistry on Host 3 by content hash. On cache miss it downloads the JAR bytes from the codebase URL over the internet, computes the SHA-256 hash, and submits the bytes to the BAE on Host 2 via JERI. Host 4 is the only component with outbound internet access. Host 2 analyses the bytes and returns the signed JarAnalysisReport to Host 4, which forwards it to Host 3. Clients discover services from Host 1 and their local ProxyCodebaseSPI checks Host 3 before unmarshalling.
svg.text: foreign service providers — untrusted, any OS
JERI · authenticated · marshalled service item + codebase URL

g.text: stores marshalled service items opaquely · does NOT unmarshal proxies · fires ServiceRegistrar events
lookup service has no BAE proxy
no VerdictRegistry proxy · no URL fetching
only component with outbound internet access · listens to lookup events · orchestrates analysis pipeline

svg.text: JERI · mutual auth · no direct path Host 2 ↔ Host 3 · no direct path Host 1 ↔ Host 2

g.text: no exec · no JNI · no FFM · no internet
any OS · inbound from Host 4 + clients
no connection to Host 1 or Host 2
verify engine public key on submit
Client hosts — any OS — ProxyCodebaseSPI present
discover from Host 1 → ProxyCodebaseSPI fires → lookup Host 3 by hash → unmarshal or refuse
